name: Zeigarnik Tension Loop
axiom: An open question keeps attention that a closed one releases.
trigger: Multi-part updates and town halls, where the audience's attention must survive several sections.

steps.text: Open a question the audience cannot answer yet.
Do other work while it stays open.
Close it explicitly before introducing the next.

antiPattern.violation: Opening loops faster than they close, which reads as incoherence rather than suspense.
antiPattern.remediation: Count them. One open question is tension; four is noise.
